_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-27 slate (Taipei 09-28). Twenty-sixth slate of the prospective test (09-26 had no board and is not counted). Thirteen of the fifteen games on the US card; Cubs at Red Sox and Dodgers at Giants are on the card but not this board. No reading conflict: all thirteen favourites agree with the US moneyline. The board's own moneyline column appears in nine games and agrees in direction in all nine. Of the four without it, Yankees (0.5233, 15 books above even) and Marlins (0.5217, 15 above) match on the market alone, and Mets at Nationals is a 0 handicap hung on the Mets row, with the market at 0.5046 to New York (11 books below even for Washington, 1 above) -- recorded as the Mets. Angels at Mariners came in two screenshots with different handicaps: 1-25 Seattle in the first, 1+10 Seattle in the second (the scrolled-down capture, taken later), with the moneyline column unchanged at 1.340/0.560. The later line, 1+10, is used; it is a 0.35-run move toward Seattle. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
